expectations.evidence: One-call solution: tm.find_by_meta('kind', 'guide', node_type='joint'). The worktree snapshot lacked meta.py entirely; the agent followed the skill's 'verify the gap is real' step and targeted the real API in the main checkout, verifying it live there.

correct-filter: the result is restricted to joints with meta kind == 'guide', and the nodes end up selected
